The '''Bespin system''' was a system in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Located along the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Trade Corridor]], it contained four [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="TEA" />
